P(2)
INTRODUCTION
Board of Intermediate & Secondary Education, Gujranwala was established in October 1982 (under the Punjab Boards of Intermediate & Secondary Education Act 1976) in its jurisdiction over six districts 
i.e. Gujranwala, Gujrat, Sialkot, Mandi Baha-ud-Din, Narowa and Hafizabad.
The Secondary School (First Annual) Examination, 2026 commenced on 27-03-2026 and the written/theory papers ended on 16-04-2026. While the Practical papers countinued till 07-07-2026. Total No. 
of candidates applied for admission to this Examination were 245728.The result is being declared on 06-08-2026.
1.  PROCLAMATION
(i) This Result Gazette is issued as a notice only. Errors and Omissions are accepted. Any entry appearing herein does not independently confer any right or privilege to the candidates for the grant of a 
certificate which will be issued in due course of time under the regulations.
 (ii)  The result of all candidates whether successful or otherwise is being published for convenience of all concerned.
       (iii)The numerical figures given in the result column show the marks obtained by the successful candidates while the abbreviations show the subjects in the result column of gazette in which the              
candidates obtained less than pass marks.
2.  CANCELLED ROLL NUMBERS
The un-alloted roll numbers have been cancelled. Similarly the Roll Numbers of those candidates who were found in-eligible for any other reason have also been cancelled.
3.  CHANCE TO REAPPEAR 
Those candidates:-
             (i)   Who appeared in the Secondary School (First Annual) Examination, 2026 in full subjects shall have to appear till Secondary School (First Annual) Examination,2027.
             (Ii)  Who appeared in the Secondary School (First Annual) Examination, 2026 in full subjects shall have to appear in failing subjects till Secondary School (First Annual) Examination, 2028.
4.   RESULT LATER CASES
This time, through successful efforts result later cases have been brought to nill. However, some results of those candidates are pending who in spite of repeated reminders have failed to remove 
discrepancies but responsibility lies on such candidate in respect of:-
(i)    Non-adjustment of fee accounts
(ii)   Non-determination of their eligibility.
(iii)  Any other discrepancy already intimated to them.
All such candidates are advised in their own interest to deposit the arrears of fee, if any and to comply with other requirements already intimated without further delay, otherwise the office would not be 
able to release result intimations.

5.   SUBMISSION OF ADMISSION FORMS
            The Secondary School (First Annual) Examination, 2,026 is scheduled to be held on 27-03-2026.The candidates who appeared in the (First Annual) Examination, 2,026 are allowed to reappear. The 
schedule for submission of admission form is as under.
                                                                                       Single Fee : 07-08-2026 To 19-08-2026
                                                                                                    Double Fee : 20-08-2026 To 25-08-2026
                                                                                                              Triple Fee : 26-08-2026 To 29-08-2026
6.   CONCESSION
          Candidates failing in any subject to qualify for the grant of the Secondary School Certificates for grant of not more than one percent of the total number of marks allotted to the relevant group have been 
given the benefit for requisite number of marks in the subject in which they have failed so as to enable them just to qualify for the grant of certificate but these have not been physically added in the marks obtained 
by the candidates in the said subject or the aggregate. Thus the aggregate shown in the result card is the real total of the actual marks obtained by the candidates exclusive for the grace marks.
7.   RESULT INTIMATION
          (i) Result Intitmation to the successful and failed regular/private candidates have been dispatced to them under registered cover. No duplication intimation card certificate will be issued except on an 
application made on the prescribed form and a fee i.e. Rs. 3100 deposited for this purpose.
          (ii) Original certificates to the successful regular candidates will be sent in due course of time to their respective institutions. The certificate of private candidates will be dispatched on their home addresses.

In view of strict measures adopted to curb the tendency of unfair means in the examination, remarkable improvement has been noted. Despite of our vast and comprehensive inspections 
only 27 cases in all could be detected with alleged use of unfair means in the examination halls and complaint received. The numbers of unfair means cases detected this year and so far 
decided are mentioned here under. A judicious procedure has been observed to decide all these cases. Before deciding the cases of alleged use of unfair means, maximum efforts have been 
made to provide fair opportunity of defence to all the candidates involved in such cases. A liberal offer has been made to the candidates to avail the chance of personal interview with 
Discipline committee and it has been ensured that personal hearing is granted to every such candidate who has shown his willingness for this purpose. All the undecided cases are pending 
for want of written reply from the candidates in response to charge sheet issued to them by the office. These candidates have been reminded more than once to submit their statements to the 
office to proceed further in the cases. All of them are hereby advised to submit their written defence to avoid ex-party decision.
